newsitem.title: USA: NEC, IBM sign hard-drive pact.
newsitem.headline: NEC, IBM sign hard-drive pact.

text.p: NEC Corp and International Business Machines Corp said they have signed an agreement to manufacture hard-disk drives.
Under the agreement, NEC will receive a license from IBM's Storage Systems Division to manufacture specific IBM-developed 3.5-inch, high-performance desktop hard disk drives.
IBM currently manufactures these drives. With the agreement, both companies will manufacture them.
These drives will then be sold by both companies under their respective brand names.

NEC currently makes 3.5-inch hard disk drives at NEC Technologies Hong Kong Ltd's contract manufacturing plant in the Philippines. NEC said it will expand that plant to a capacity of five million disk drives per year by fall of 1998.
NEC will start to manufacture these hard disk drives and is planning to ship them early next year, it said.
